name: Thinkific
description: Thinkific is a powerful platform designed to help educators and entrepreneurs create, market, and sell online courses. With a user-friendly interface and a variety of customization options, Thinkific makes it easy to build engaging and interactive learning experiences.

events.d: Enroll a student in a course and optionally set activation or expiry dates; returns an existing enrollment if one exists.
Create a coupon code for a promotion.

events.n: When a new user is created
events.d: Runs the workflow automatically when a new user is created in your Thinkific account.
Retrieve courses from your Thinkific site (supports pagination).

Find users on your site using pagination and optional filters (email, role, group, external source, or custom profile field).
Change a learner's course enrollment activation and expiry dates.
Retrieve enrollments and filter by student email or course, status (full, free trial, completed, expired), created/updated date (specific or relative), and paginate results.
Add an existing user to one or more groups using their email.

events.n: When a new order is created

Create a discount promotion for selected courses or products, with optional start/end dates, duration, and coupon codes.
Retrieve promotions to view or manage (supports pagination).
Create multiple coupon codes for a promotion, specifying total quantity, optional uses per coupon, and code length.
Retrieve coupons for a specific promotion.
Get a paginated list of groups.
Set a promotion's start to Today or a custom date, and its end to an exact date or a duration in days.
Create a group by specifying its name.
